Package org.apache.maven.plugins.javadoc

Class JavadocNoForkReport

java.lang.Object
org.apache.maven.plugin.AbstractMojo
org.apache.maven.plugins.javadoc.AbstractJavadocMojo
org.apache.maven.plugins.javadoc.JavadocReport
org.apache.maven.plugins.javadoc.JavadocNoForkReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.maven.plugin.ContextEnabled, org.apache.maven.plugin.Mojo, org.apache.maven.reporting.MavenMultiPageReport, org.apache.maven.reporting.MavenReport
@Mojo(name="javadoc-no-fork", requiresDependencyResolution=COMPILE, threadSafe=true) @Execute(phase=NONE) public class JavadocNoForkReport extends JavadocReport
Generates documentation for the Java code in a NON aggregator project using the standard Javadoc Tool. Note that this goal does require generation of sources before site generation, e.g. by invoking mvn clean deploy site.
Since:
2.10
Author:
Mirko Friedenhagen
